generations.conceptPrompt: Canvas cash sack of a late-1980s Eastern-bloc bank: a lumpy bag stuffed with banknotes, a gathered neck tied with a drawstring or strap, and a plain stencilled panel or patch on the front. Grey-brown coarse hessian sack, tall, rope wound around the neck, a faded band. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
